result.markdown:
For a small business, my overall recommendation would be **Dropbox Sign or DocuSign**, depending on how many contracts you send and how much automation you need.

Since you're in Australia, I'd also consider a couple of Australian-focused options, particularly if you use Xero or MYOB.

## Best e-signature software compared

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Very easy to use.
- Clean signing experience for customers.
- Templates, reminders and audit trails.
- Good for contracts, agreements and approvals.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall functionality)

- Well-established and widely recognised.
- Excellent document tracking.
- Templates, workflows and integrations.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.

Website: [DocuSign Australia](https://www.docusign.com/en-au)

---

![Annature](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ajDlQ4iEQSWiUrNSiiYa3PBzbS3E9LMmDFEF5w0gC4YywypR_OfCZzcQHGxmJ93Bw6W3kdLOStVGOC-XwiIfrfKAb-cJF-VTKTaiR_YKNe2-JEBWth8EYs4f7BuBWLrJPCGttgYvC70mNM3hL8x1nwdBtEahr-UR1AnN82qozDuJ_Y6oAVb82lBSb8Ghj0f5?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Annature**

(Best Australian-focused option)

- Australian e-signature provider.
- Designed for Australian business workflows.
- Worth considering for local data-hosting requirements.
- Particularly interesting for professional services.

Website: [Annature](https://www.annature.com.au/)

---

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho Sign**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable plans and a free tier.
- Integrates with Zoho CRM and other Zoho products.
- Templates and automated signing workflows.
- Good for smaller teams.

Website: [Zoho Sign](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. PandaDoc**

(Best for proposals and sales)

- Create professional quotes and proposals.
- Add pricing tables and approval steps.
- Collect signatures and track document activity.
- Particularly good for sales-oriented businesses.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Main strength | Best suited to |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Simplicity | Small businesses |
| DocuSign | Features and integrations | Growing businesses |
| Annature | Australian workflows | Australian SMEs |
| Zoho Sign | Affordability | Budget-conscious businesses |
| PandaDoc | Proposals and quotes | Sales teams |


These are my recommendations based on functionality and typical small-business needs, rather than a definitive ranking. Pricing and document limits vary by plan. [www.starworks.com.au](https://www.starworks.com.au/best/software/e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[serpastra.com](https://serpastra.com/blog/best-e-signature-software-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for before choosing

I'd prioritise these five features\:

1. **Reusable templates** – Create a contract once and reuse it.
2. **Automatic reminders** – Chase customers who haven't signed.
3. **Audit trail** – Record when documents are sent, viewed and signed.
4. **Multiple signatories** – Allow multiple people to sign the same agreement.
5. **Integrations** – Connect with your CRM, accounting software or cloud storage.

One Australian consideration: electronic signatures are legally recognised for many transactions under the Electronic Transactions Act 1999 and corresponding state legislation, although certain documents have exceptions. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
